get.description:
Several measures, never one percentage.

A single number hides the difference between "not written yet" and "cannot
be proven", and those need different people to do different things.

The requirements behind any readiness number.

Accepts a readiness state (`READY`, `BLOCKED`, ...), an evidence status
(`CURRENT_VERIFIED`, `EXPIRED`, ...), or one of `UNASSESSED`,
`CRITICAL_BLOCKERS`, `OUTSTANDING_ACTIONS`, `MANDATORY_UNREADY`.

get.description: Everything needed to answer 'why can I not finish this task?'.

What this task may do next, and which moves need a reason.

Exposed so a caller never has to guess the state machine, and so a UI can
disable a button rather than offer a move that will be refused.

Exactly what the model was shown for this answer, and why.

The route an investigator takes after a suspected leak. Without it, "the
